# Learned instinct: ansible-idempotency-required (confidence 0.97)

Every Ansible task must be idempotent — running the play twice on the same host must produce no changes on the second run. Tasks using `command` or `shell` modules must include `creates:`, `removes:`, or `changed_when: false` to achieve idempotency. The Molecule idempotence test validates this in CI.

Source: Ansible best practices — idempotency; ansible-lint rule [no-changed-when]
